chapter_title: FROM THE RULERS TO THE RULED TYPES OF GOVERNMENTS

items.title: What is a Government?
items.explanation: A government is an organized system that manages the affairs of a country. Its main functions include maintaining law and order, ensuring peace and security, managing national defense, delivering essential services like education and healthcare, and working for the welfare of the people.

items.title: What is Democracy?
items.explanation: Democracy means 'rule of the people.' In a democratic government, the source of power and authority comes from the citizens themselves. This is often compared to a school where students choose representatives through voting to make decisions on their behalf.

items.title: What are the Duties of a Ruler?
items.explanation: The duties of a ruler in internal administration include three-fold: rakṣha (protection from external aggression), pālana (maintenance of law and order), and yogakṣhema (safeguarding the welfare of the people).
